steps: Multiplying both sides by (x − 4) is only valid when that factor is non-zero, so x = 4 was excluded from the original domain.

Substituting x = 4 into the original equation makes a denominator zero, so it is undefined there and cannot be a solution.
x = 3 lies in the domain and satisfies the equation, so only x = 3 is genuine.
